events.description: Large crowd of protesters wearing yellow vests engaged in violent unrest, with thick smoke rising from the left side of the frame, indicating deployment of tear gas or burning debris; movement suggests active confrontation and chaos.

Sudden large fire erupts at location previously obscured by smoke; rapid ignition and expansion suggest an explosive event (e.g., vehicle or container ignited violently), distinct from gradual fire growth.

Sustained violent unrest: large fire continues to burn intensely in street, surrounded by scattered protesters and smoke; scene remains chaotic with no signs of containment, consistent with ongoing riot conditions.
A sudden, large plume of dark smoke erupts from the ground near a roadside barrier, with visible fire and debris ejection in frames f0–f9; consistent with an explosive device detonation.

Group of people, many wearing yellow vests, engaged in violent unrest: running, throwing objects, and clashing amid heavy smoke (likely tear gas or smoke grenades); police presence implied by uniformed figures and crowd dispersal behavior.

Multiple individuals are seen moving rapidly through dense smoke or tear gas in an urban street setting, consistent with a violent protest dispersal. Figures appear to be fleeing or advancing amid chaos; some wear masks or coverings. The persistent haze and erratic movement across frames indicate ongoing collective unrest.

Multiple individuals are seen moving through dense smoke or tear gas in an urban street setting, consistent with a violent protest dispersal; some wear masks and move evasively, indicating active unrest.

A water cannon vehicle is actively deploying a high-pressure water jet toward a group of people on the street, causing visible dispersion and chaos—characteristic of riot control during violent protests.
Sustained violent unrest with a vehicle engulfed in flames, heavy smoke, and large crowds surrounding police vehicles; consistent with riot conditions during Yellow Vest protests.

Initial intense fireball and rapid expansion of flames at the vehicle, suggesting an explosive ignition event (e.g., fuel tank rupture or incendiary device), though sustained fire dominates subsequent frames.
